source_suites.name: ARC-AGI-3
source_suites.task_contract: An agent receives a turn-based 64x64-or-smaller 16-color frame and available actions, but no natural-language objective or mechanics. It must discover the world rules and win condition, then complete levels efficiently.
source_suites.notes: The 135 environments comprise 25 public demos, 55 semi-private environments, and 55 fully private environments. Only the three anonymous public examples are itemized here until the remaining public IDs can be authenticated through the official API.

source_suites.name: DiG-bench
source_suites.task_contract: An agent interacts with a text game through JSON states and legal actions, experiments to infer unique hidden transformation rules and win conditions, and must beat the game within its fixed step budget.

aggregate_results.system: Claude Opus 5 basic harness, games won out of 70
Gemini 3.1 Pro basic harness without rules, games won out of 70
Qwen 3.6 27B basic harness, games won out of 70

source_suites.notes: The public set contains P-1 through P-21, three games in each of seven difficulty tiers. The remaining 49 games are private and are not itemized.

source_suites.name: SimpleTES
source_suites.task_contract: Each task supplies an instruction, an editable seed program, and an executable evaluator that validates constraints and recomputes the score in an isolated subprocess.
source_suites.notes: The current paper reports gpt-oss-120b as the evaluated generator; matched runs for the five tracked frontier model families remain open.
